Scorpions greet Bangladesh on Independence Day
2017-03-26T23:42:14+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/music/scorpions-greet-bangladesh-independence-day-1381987

Legendary rock band Scorpions have extended their greetings to the fans in Bangladesh on the Independence Day in a Facebook post.

In Facebook wall, the German hard rock band wrote, “Huge shoutout to our fans in #Bangladesh! The Scorpions love you.”
